encryption.rule: Never store the age identity beside backup artifacts; rotate recipients by retaining old identities until all corresponding backups expire.

integrity.rule: A backup without all three artifacts or with any digest mismatch is invalid.

redis.backup: RDB point-in-time snapshot, age encrypted; PostgreSQL remains authoritative for durable business state

objects.backup: MinIO bucket mirror, age encrypted; enable bucket versioning/replication separately where historical versions are required

config.backup: deployment env, Compose topology, migration runner and PostgreSQL migration definitions, age encrypted

consistency.redis: Redis RDB snapshot; not transactionally coordinated with PostgreSQL
consistency.objects: MinIO mirror is a point-in-time traversal, not a version-preserving atomic snapshot
consistency.configuration: Captured at backup invocation; secrets encrypted and excluded from repository history
consistency.cross_component: No cross-component atomic checkpoint is claimed; record run timestamps and reconcile references before production cutover.

verification.routine: after each backup batch and at least daily
checks: JSON manifest format and artifact name
manifest digest equals encrypted payload digest
age authentication and native payload format when decrypt enabled
verification.failure_action: quarantine failed artifact from restore selection; investigate and rerun backup
